concurrency: Single-threaded pure compilation; one bounded compile per call over immutable normalized resources; no shared mutable state, no worker, thread, coroutine, timer, or background work.
deployment: Offline, in-process library call inside the admitted XDL1 envelope: no process, service, container, network, device, artifact, or registry is created, started, probed, or contacted.
rationale: Source allocation from docs/engineering/xdl-lite/requirements.md XDL1-SR-010, realized by XDL1-ARCH-03, XDL1-ARCH-06 in docs/engineering/xdl-lite/architecture.md section 4 and frozen in docs/engineering/xdl-lite/detailed-design.md.
responsibilities: Record declared model and artifact binding references with their declared revisions as explicit references in the plan.
Retrieve, fetch, unpack, execute, or claim availability or readiness of no artifact.
Reject a referenced artifact that declares no immutable pin.
state_ownership: Owns no durable or cached state. Receives immutable NormalizedResource values and returns a fresh plain plan dict plus sorted diagnostics; persists, journals, and mutates nothing.
title: XDL1-SR-010-CMP allocation - Model and artifact binding references recorded as references only
